﻿# Fix Maven Compilation Failure: asto-core v1.13.0 -> v1.14.1

## Context

Project `docker-adapter` (by artipie) has a **COMPILATION_FAILURE** after a dependency upgrade bot bumped
`com.artipie:asto-core` from `v1.13.0` to `v1.14.1` (other update).

Reference PR: https://github.com/artipie/docker-adapter/pull/536

## Your Task

The source code is in `/docker-adapter`. Fix all compilation errors so that `mvn compile` succeeds.

The compilation errors have been fixed. Here's a summary of what was done:

## Summary

Fixed compilation errors caused by the hamcrest API change in `StringContains` and `StringStartsWith` constructors. The old API accepted `(boolean ignoreCase, String substring)` but the newer version only accepts `(String substring)`.

**Files fixed (9 total):**

1. `src/test/java/com/artipie/docker/http/DockerAuthITCase.java` - 2 occurrences
2. `src/test/java/com/artipie/docker/asto/AstoBlobsITCase.java` - 2 occurrences
3. `src/test/java/com/artipie/docker/http/DockerSliceITCase.java` - 5 occurrences
4. `src/test/java/com/artipie/docker/http/UploadEntityPostTest.java` - 1 occurrence (StringStartsWith)
5. `src/test/java/com/artipie/docker/http/CachingProxyITCase.java` - 1 occurrence
6. `src/test/java/com/artipie/docker/http/UploadEntityRequestTest.java` - 2 occurrences
7. `src/test/java/com/artipie/docker/ref/ManifestRefTest.java` - 2 occurrences
8. `src/test/java/com/artipie/docker/http/LargeImageITCase.java` - 2 occurrences
9. `src/test/java/com/artipie/docker/TagValidTest.java` - 2 occurrences

Both `mvn compile` and `mvn test-compile` now succeed.
